analyst_view.overall: Early view: Union host Hamburg in a game between two sides who have struggled for goals: Union have scored seven in nine and still lack a reliable striker, Hamburg ten. Hamburg have lost four of five away games, while Union have become much harder to break down since their poor start under Mauro Lustrinelli.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.6 goals. I lean lower: Union's recent league games have been low-scoring, built on a deeper block, and Hamburg have scored only ten all season. The main route to a higher total is Hamburg's defence, which has conceded 20.

corners.text: The site expects 9.3 corners. Union at home will push more than they do away, while Hamburg's attack relies on long-range shots rather than crosses, so I see no reason to move far from the number.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.7 cards. I lean slightly higher: seven yellows were shown when Köln visited the Alte Försterei, and Hamburg took four at Frankfurt. Two sides in the lower half meeting in December is rarely a calm game.

shots.text: The site has 25.9 shots. Union had no first-half shots at Freiburg and Hamburg's thin squad has limited options in attack, so I lean lower.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.7 on target. With both attacks among the weakest in the league by goals scored, I lean slightly lower.
